title: Marilyn C NDE 6829
content: I began to feel sleepy with the loss of blood. I lost consciousness on the way to emergency surgery. I became aware that I was no longer on the gurney but streaking through a tunnel at a high rate of speed. At the same time, I understood that I was no longer in my body. At some point, my speed began to falter and I found myself floating in a void filled with balls of light. It was not a tunnel I had passed through, it was just the same visual effect as traveling at warp speed through the stars. I had been traveling through a field of lights in a void. As I slowed, I could hear disembodied voices murmuring around me, and I realized I was just a glowing ball of energy, though I was thinking clearly to myself, questioning my own presence. At the same time, I understood the other voices emanated from the energies that surrounded me and they, too, were thinking similar thoughts that I could hear. As I drifted and listened to the voices, I had no sense of the past or the future, only the present. Then I felt myself physically slammed back to where I found myself in bed, hooked up to a blood transfusion in post op. The doctor never discussed what exactly happened to me before they performed the surgery, but I strongly suspect I nearly died in childbirth. I have an entirely different perspective on death now and I don't believe religion enters into it much at all, except maybe to those who need it as a crutch to get through life in general.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Initially described as "streaking through a tunnel" at high speed; later clarified it was like traveling at warp speed through stars/a field of lights in a void rather than a literal tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: Void filled with "balls of light"; heard disembodied voices that she understood were emanating from surrounding energies.

environment.environment_other_detail: A void filled with balls/field of lights (like stars).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Loss of blood and loss of consciousness on the way to emergency surgery; experiencer suspects she nearly died in childbirth.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transition from high-speed tunnel/warp-like travel into a void with balls of light; heard disembodied voices/thoughts from surrounding energies.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel described then reinterpreted as warp-speed travel through a field of lights in a void; no light-being/life review/boundary reported.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneously understood she was out of her body while streaking through the tunnel/field of lights.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel experience reframed as a warp-speed/starfield visual effect rather than a literal tunnel; multiple "balls of light" with audible/telepathically accessible thoughts.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "streaking through a tunnel at a high rate of speed"; "floating in a void filled with balls of light"; "I realized I was just a glowing ball of energy"; "I had no sense of the past or the future, only the present"; "physically slammed back"
